description: A 24-hour dynamic population distribution dataset based on mobile phone data from Helsinki Metropolitan Area, Finland is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Claudia Bergroth, Olle Järv (Unit of Urban Research and Statistics, City of Helsinki / Digital Geography Lab, Department of Geosciences and). Related article: Bergroth, C., Järv, O., Tenkanen, H., Manninen, M., Toivonen, T., 2022. A 24-hour population distribution dataset based on mobile phone data from Helsinki Metropolitan Area, Finland. Scientific Data 9, 39. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
